description: List projects (id, name, code, client_id, active, billable, budget_hours, users, managers), optionally filtered. Paymo: GET /api/projects.

include.description: Related objects to embed (Paymo `include`), comma-separated, e.g. client or tasklists.tasks.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 100, max 500). Paymo has no pagination; results beyond this are truncated.

user_id.description: Only projects this user is assigned to.

where.description: Extra raw Paymo filter ANDed onto the typed ones, e.g. `billable=true` or `name like Website`. Operators: = > >= < <= != like, not like, in (a,b), not in (a,b).

name: paymo_list_projects
title: List projects
